description.en: Miniature blocks at an isometric angle, flat toned surfaces and paths that sit on a grid.
description.tr: İzometrik açıda minyatür bloklar, düz tonlu yüzeyler ve ızgaraya oturan yollar.

colorRules.accent: the path, the signal, the highlighted object; one accent idea per scene

numerals.use: extruded 3D numbers, lying in the isometric planes

camera.projection: true isometric: rotation x 35.264 deg, y 45 deg
camera.moves: pan and zoom only, the angle never changes

shading.mode: flat per face, no textures, no reflections

grid.rule: every object sits on whole grid units

enter.type: rise from below the tile or drop from above, snap to grid

grow.use: bars extrude up, paths extend segment by segment

motion.transition: camera pans along the grid to the next tile, or the tile flips down and the next tile rises
